parole.significato: the Shabbat, Sabbath, a day of rest for Jewish people
parole.testo: Borrowed from Polish szabas from Yiddish שבת (shabes, “Sabbath”), from Hebrew שַׁבָּת (shabát). Doublet of субо́та (subóta) and ша́бас (šábas).
